headline: Best Gathering Pal in Palworld
title: Best Gathering Pal in Palworld | Jetragon | Palworld Base Guide
video_script: Who is the best Gathering Pal in Palworld one point zero? It's Jetragon, with level eight Gathering. Yes, the legendary Jetragon is also the best gatherer in the game! The best alternative is Frostallion Noct, with level seven Gathering, and it works at night. Tip: condense your workers to four stars to raise every work level by one. Who does Gathering at your base? Comment below!
